data.title: FOPE Launches First Single-Brand Boutique in China at Hong Kong’s Harbour City
data.description:
FOPE S.p.A. ( (IT:FPE) ) has issued an announcement.

FOPE Group is expanding its presence in Asia with the launch of its first single-brand boutique in China, opening on 30 September in Hong Kong’s Harbour City mall in partnership with its local distributor. The boutique is aligned with the brand’s image and quality standards and marks a concrete step in the company’s strategy to strengthen its positioning in the high-end jewellery segment within the Chinese market.

The Hong Kong store inaugurates a broader, progressive plan for new openings over the coming years, agreed with the Chinese market partner as part of FOPE’s long-term growth strategy. This move underscores China’s role as a key strategic area for FOPE’s international expansion and is expected to enhance brand visibility and support its ambition to consolidate its status in the global luxury jewellery industry.

More about FOPE S.p.A.

FOPE S.p.A. is a historic Italian goldsmith company founded in Vicenza in 1929 and a leading player in the high-end jewellery sector, listed on Euronext Growth Milan. With more than 110 employees and about 87% of revenues generated abroad, it focuses on the international luxury market, combining craftsmanship, proprietary Made in Italy technology and recognisable design to serve over 700 points of sale worldwide.

The group operates through subsidiaries in the U.S., UK, Germany, Japan and Dubai, relying on direct relationships with multi-brand luxury jewellers rather than intermediaries to ensure loyalty and strong after-sales service. All production is carried out in-house at its Vicenza headquarters, supported by R&D-driven standardisation and automation, and FOPE is a certified member of the Responsible Jewellery Council, publishing a Sustainability Report under ESRS since 2017.

data.title: Vee S.A. to Overhaul Reporting of Operational Metrics
data.description:
An announcement from Vee SA ( (PL:VEE) ) is now available.

Vee S.A. has announced it will stop regularly publishing data on the number of handled cases and Minutes of Processed Conversations in their current format, arguing that these volume metrics no longer adequately reflect the scale or economics of the Group’s operations. As the business model has shifted toward success-based and KPI-driven settlements, a given volume of cases or minutes can now correspond to very different economic values.

The company is developing a new approach to presenting operational data that emphasizes efficiency indicators tailored to specific campaigns and settlement models, aiming to give investors and stakeholders a clearer view of operational scale, effectiveness, and the linkage between performance and revenue. Methodology and scope for these new metrics are still being refined, and Vee plans to announce the adopted formula in a separate communication.
